newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: TENNIS-TOP SEED PAULUS OUT INJURED.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-TOP SEED PAULUS OUT INJURED.

text.p: An elbow injury forced top seed Austrian Barbara Paulus to hand Spain's Maria Sanchez-Lorenzo a walkover into the $107,000 Styrian Open semifinals on Friday.

The defending champion's withdrawal set up a last-four clash between the unseeded Sanchez-Lorenzo and Barbara Schett after the Austrian fifth seed scored a surprise 3-6 7-5 6-0 victory over compatriot and third seed Judith Wiesner.

Saturday's other semifinal will be between Slovakian sixth seed Henrieta Nagyova and Meike Babel, of Germany. Nagyova beat fourth-seeded Swiss Patty Schnyder 0-6 6-4 6-2 and Babel made short work of Spain's Gala Leon-Garcia 6-3 6-1.
World number 14 Paulus, who captured her sixth career title in Warsaw last week, was reported to be suffering from tendinitis in her right elbow.
She first began to feel the pain in Poland last Sunday when rain forced the semifinals and final to be played on the same day.
"The pain was so strong this morning, it would have been silly to play," explained Paulus, who hopes to regain full fitness for the U.S. Open which starts on August 25.
